title: Gavia Course 0 Tubeless Tyre
notes: Official UK store read 2026-11-01: £54.99; sizes offered 700x28c and 700x30c; 'Hookless compatible'. Premium road race tire; 170 TPI casing; RR-S compound; Race Shield Kevlar puncture protection; carbon/Kevlar folding bead. Specification lists 700x25C 85-125 psi (5.8-8.6 bar), about 315 g, and 700x28C 80-105 psi (5.5-7.2 bar), about 335 g.
